items.title: Judge Pauses Rollout of N.Y.C. Second-Home Tax, Dealing Blow to Mamdani
items.author: Mihir Zaveri and Mark Bonamo
items.content: <article>A group of homeowners had sued the city, arguing that the introduction of the tax was mishandled. After the judge issued an order pausing the rollout, the city said it would appeal.</article>

items.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
items.author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs
items.content: <article>Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”</article>

items.title: Trump Wants to Move On From the Middle East. It’s Not Letting Him.
items.author: Anton Troianovski

items.title: Here Is Where Colombia’s Quake Hit Hardest

items.title: A Nighttime New York Boat Tour Turned Deadly in a Matter of Moments
items.author: Miles G. Cohen and Christopher Maag

items.title: Captain Charged in N.Y.C. Accident That Killed Mother and Daughter
items.author: Benjamin Weiser, Patrick McGeehan and Miles G. Cohen
